answer.reason: The verses give two things the summary lacks: his yearly worship at Shiloh and Eli's blessing of him.

clauses.english: went up yearly to worship and sacrifice to the LORD at Shiloh
clauses.quote: yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the LORD of hosts in Shiloh

clauses.english: was blessed by Eli together with his wife
clauses.quote: Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife

doubts: 1SA 1:3 is a context verse, not marked, but it is the one that states the yearly worship.
1CH 6:27 and 1CH 6:34 are genealogy entries that may concern other men named Elkanah; they were left out.
